description: Report-only macOS junk scans before/after current bulk file-fact traversal and removal of redundant persisted length indexes from the default path. Results remain fresh traversals; this measures OS-warmed performance rather than whole-root cache replay.

final.buildLabel: f4b69aadc3dc294204c5623c77df8fd27298d929 plus working-tree hot-junk changes release Rust 1.98.0

workload.pairedInvocationOrder: odd repetitions baseline then final; even repetitions final then baseline
workload.states: existing state-large-{repetition mod 3}; legacy 8 file indexes confirmed before every invocation

cacheState.osCache: uncontrolled, warmed by prior scans, never flushed
cacheState.sweepxCache: prepopulated legacy state with candidate rows and file indexes; writes included in timings
cacheState.fsevents: final default path does not request FSEvents history; baseline still does

limitations: 5 runs per binary; no tail-percentile inference
OS/cache interference and other host activity uncontrolled
wall includes process startup, tool probes, cache publication and result output
phase medians need not add to wall median
both roots use live traversal; zero root hits are diagnostic, not a skipped-traversal claim

baselineDefaultGeneratedFixture.osCache: uncontrolled; cold means empty SweepX cache only

baselineLargerSequentialConditions.control: No explicit state and child environment omits HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME; default state unavailable. Dynamic tool config context can differ and is excluded from equivalence.

interpretationLimits: Primary before/after evidence uses the same unchanged 65,536-artifact fixture and populated legacy cache states, with five alternating pairs.
Default harness before/after runs generated distinct fixture paths at distinct times; they are supporting validation, not a paired timing comparison.
Final default small-fixture warm median is slower than its cold median, with 87.1 ms median cache publication; do not claim a speedup for every workload.
Neither path skips whole roots: every sample reports zero whole-root hits. FSEvents history does not establish whole-root freshness.
Unavailable-state baseline control changes the child HOME/XDG_STATE_HOME environment; it compares only filesystem quantities and excludes environment-dependent tool interpretation.
Temporary paths name local evidence artifacts and fixtures retained at measurement time; they are not portable reproduction locations.
Hardware model and physical memory unavailable under host sandbox; macOS version, release, architecture, Rust toolchain and binary SHA-256 are recorded.
